hero.h1_classes: text-white text-4xl md:text-6xl xl:text-7xl tracking-tight leading-[1.05] mb-8 reveal-target
hero.cta_classes: inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-white px-4 py-2 text-xs font-normal text-black hover:bg-zinc-200 transition-colors

keyframes_css: @keyframes dash { 0% { stroke-dasharray: 0, 20; stroke-dashoffset: 0; } 50% { stroke-dasharray: 10, 10; stroke-dashoffset: -5; } 100% { stroke-dasharray: 20, 0; stroke-dashoffset: -10; } }
@keyframes floating-points { 0% { transform: translateY(0); } 85% { opacity: 0; } 100% { transform: translateY(-55px); opacity: 0; } }
